source_caption_text:
8 years ago today Kodak released ‘ZEZE’ with Offset and Travis Scott 🔥😮‍💨

Who still has it in rotation??

It’s hard to believe it’s been 8 full years since Kodak Black, Travis Scott, and Offset dropped “ZEZE” and instantly changed the culture. That iconic D.A. Doman tropical steel drum intro played out of every speaker all year long, and the numbers behind this smash hit are absolutely ridiculous.
The track debuted straight at number 2 on the Billboard Hot 100 on October 27, 2018, while claiming the number 1 spot on both the Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart and the US Rhythmic chart. It was a complete streaming powerhouse from day one, pulling in a massive 59.8 million US streams in its very first week to top the Billboard Streaming Songs chart alongside 17,000 digital downloads.
Today, “ZEZE” stands officially certified 6x Platinum by the RIAA with over 6 million units sold in the United States alone. It holds over 1.2 billion streams on Spotify, making it the most-streamed track of Kodak Black’s entire career, while the hilarious Travis Scott-directed music video has surpassed 500 million views on YouTube. The anthem made global waves too, earning 5x Platinum status in Canada, 2x Platinum in Australia, and Platinum certification in the UK.
